title: Blind Crown — Refined Edition
description: Private-plan archery for 2–10 contestant slots. Choose a position and aim, lock your plan, then watch the simultaneous reveal and volley. This unchanged v1.4 standalone supports one local player with bots, three arenas and four views. First/third-person views default to Canvas 2.5D; hosted phone-room multiplayer is not integrated.
